# Account Hub cancellation tests check UI outcomes and wait separately for native account creation

The owned initial-discovery test checks Cancel localization, Back hidden after cancel and footer re-enabled. Password/OAuth creation assertions keep Back hidden; the OAuth task cancels through Escape in its popup and checks config view, nonbusy state, no account and restored Back. The sync task separately waits for a native account before cancellation, then checks error notification and hidden SelectAll controls and removes the account in cleanup. Those state assertions do not prove immediate DAV transport abort, every timing between discovery awaits, overlay layering, Exchange autodiscover popup cancellation, add-on install cancellation or live accessibility. The native account wait is separate from verification completion, whose backend handoff remains unawaited. Landed messages are nonempty and contain expected behavior; punctuation remains mixed across files. Accepted later source uses clearer show-cancel-text wording, keeps OAuth Back visible with an extra popup-close test, and changes sync to Skip/success. These later scenarios are not credited to the owned test landing. No test or provider operation was executed.

Scope: mail/test/account-hub-cancellation.
